Gauge.Name: Auto-STOL
Gauge.Comment:
This gauge controls an auto-STOL takeoff in Dino Catteneo's F-35B.
AutoSTOLTakeoff can only be selected when: - Aircraft on the ground, in STOL configuration, and engine running. - Brakes (normal or parking brakes) are applied.
When selected, releasing the brakes will activate AutoSTOLTakeoff. When active, AutoSTOLTakeoff is de-activated when: - CTOL min. airspeed is reached (now: 160 Knots) - Brakes are applied (abort AutoSTOLTakeoff)
The Lvar (L:STOLAutoTakeoff,enum) can be used in the VC to display the state of the AutoSTOLTakeoff function: - 0: No AutoSTOLTakeoff possible; not on the ground, or engine not running, or brakes not released. - 1: AutoSTOLTakeoff possible; awaiting AutoSTOLTakeoff selection. - 2: Selected; awaiting Brakes release or abort. - 3: Active; throttling up and accelerating on the ground. When takeoff speed is reached and after liftoff, gear is retracted. - 4: Active; accelerating in the air, with a fixed 6-degree pitchup attitude. When min. CTOL speed is reached, CTOL configuration is set, Flaps are retracted and control is released.
The XML code for the selection clickspot in the VC should be:
************* (L:STOLAutoTakeoff,enum) 1 == if{ 2 (>L:STOLAutoTakeoff,enum) } els{ (L:STOLAutoTakeoff,enum) 2 == if{ 0 (>L:STOLAutoTakeoff,enum) } } *************
Alternative to a mouse click in the VC, you can use a keystroke/button assigned to the FS function "Carb heat/eng anti-ice (on/off)" The default FSX key is "H". FOR TESTPURPOSES ONLY; WILL BE REMOVED WHEN VC CLICKSPOT CAN BE USED
V3.0 - Based on new elevator control in STOL config. Works with _function gauge V30.15 and up
